_comment: Bundled vocabulary for the threat-model validator (contract requirement 3).
Kept in sync with contract/threat-model.schema.json by scripts/check_repo.py.
These are the SHAPES a threat model and a risk can take: the Open Threat Model version this
piece reads, the kinds of element a threat can sit on, and the status/category/likelihood/impact
values Noru's own API publishes for a risk. They are not framework content: no control text, no
threat library, no catalogue of mitigations. Which risks already exist and which controls a risk
may be linked to come from the customer's organization at scan time, never from this file. See
risk_status, risk_category, likelihood and impact are the published values for a Noru risk:
the 'Create risk' entry of https://api.noru.tech/llms.txt and the createRisk tool description
published by https://api.noru.tech/v1/mcp. Do not extend them here.
_score_bands_comment: How a threat's OTM likelihood and impact, each 0 to 100, become the values the skeleton proposes:
five equal bands, lowest first. A proposal only: the person who owns the risk decides.
_status_horizon_days_comment: How long the judgement about a threat may stand, counted in days from the day the model was
observed (the commit date of the scanned state). A threat model goes stale as the system it
describes changes; this says when somebody has to look again, not when the risk is due.
Accepting a risk is a decision to live with it, and gets a longer window, never an unbounded one.
